items.title: Will Direct TPU Sales Re-Rate Google Stock?
items.summary: Quietly, a merchant silicon business is emerging inside the world's largest advertising platform. The company has now started delivering its custom TPU systems directly into customer data centers. This marks a fundamental expansion of the business model, moving from selling services to selling the core hardware that powers the AI transition.
